name: The Creative Loft
description: The Creative Loft is a bright and modern creative space designed for photography sessions, content creation, and professional projects. Enjoy a comfortable environment with plenty of room to bring your ideas to life.

name: Modern Workspace
description: Modern Workspace offers a productive and inspiring environment for freelancers, designers, and creative teams. Work comfortably in a professional setting with essential workspace facilities.

name: The White Room
description: The White Room is a versatile photography space with a clean and minimal environment. It is suitable for portraits, product photography, creative campaigns, and personal photoshoots.

name: Urban Creative Space
description: Urban Creative Space is a flexible venue for creative workshops, small exhibitions, team gatherings, and community events. Its open layout makes it easy to arrange the space for different activities.

name: The Focus Studio
description: The Focus Studio provides a quiet and comfortable environment for meetings, planning sessions, interviews, and collaborative work. It is designed to help small teams stay focused and productive.

name: Lightbox Studio
description: Lightbox Studio is a creative photography environment suitable for portraits, product shoots, and content production. The space offers a simple and comfortable setup for creative projects.
